sections.title: Virginia real estate transfer tax

rows.label: State recordation tax on deeds
rows.value: $0.25 per $100 of consideration or value, whichever is greater

rows.label: Grantor tax
rows.value: $0.50 per $500 of consideration or value, paid by the grantor
rows.note: Excludes liens remaining on the property. Grantor and grantee may agree that the grantee pays.

source.title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-802 (Additional tax paid by grantor)

rows.label: City or county recordation tax
rows.value: Up to one-third of the state recordation tax

source.title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-814 (City or county recordation tax)

rows.label: Northern Virginia regional WMATA capital fee
rows.value: $0.10 per $100 of consideration or value, paid by the grantor
rows.note: Applies in counties and cities that are members of the Northern Virginia Transportation Authority.

source.title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-802.3 (Regional transportation improvement fee)
